forum.title: Non standard preamble on STM32WL33
forum.best_answer_content:
Hi DirkH,

yes, you can use the Direct through buffer mode, so you can implement your protocol bypassing any packet handler constraint.

BR,

Filippo
forum.content_text: I need to implement a protocol using 11110000 as preamble. The protocol is 2-FSK 868.1 MHz, +/-35kHz, 25kbps. According to RM0511 STM32WL33 only supports 01010101 or 10101010 as preamble for 2-FSK. Is it feasible to use the STM32WL33? I am planning to use direct buffer mode.
forum.author: DirkH

scraped_replies.html:
Hi DirkH, 

yes, you can use the Direct through buffer mode, so you can implement your protocol bypassing any packet handler constraint.

BR,
Filippo
